static_traits.name: 周伟
static_traits.social_status: 社交意愿下降、Meeting new friends的Reduced motivation；有一位提供实际支持的朋友，但not愿与其讨论个人感受
static_traits.medical_history: 有肢体残疾（without法行走），without其他显著躯体疾病；此前without心理问题就诊/治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清楚，能描述自动化思维与情绪；Neutral attitude且带有怀疑，但愿意合作与探索

basic_info.main_problem: 我想讨论的主要问题是：我相信我的残疾会阻碍我找到伴侣，这一信念导致我感到Loneliness和悲伤。
basic_info.core_demands: I am seeking counseling now because I have noticed that this belief has significantly affected my daily life and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: 三年前经历了一段感情的结束，由此trigger了“因为残疾找not到伴侣”的信念；此后在约会中的多次not顺利Reinforcement了该信念，Seeing happy couples或想到not yet来时负面情绪更强烈（Loneliness、悲伤）。
长期存在的身体残疾导致without法行走；在社交与亲密关系领域，周伟倾向将残疾视为主要障碍，逐渐Reduced socializing与自我照顾。

core_beliefs: 我是有缺陷的，因此not值得被爱

special_situations.event: 在街上或社交媒体上Seeing happy couples
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人都有伴侣而我have not，就说明我的残疾决定了我not可能拥有亲密关系
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced socializing、避免去认识新朋友以规避比较与可能的拒绝
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远找not到伴侣；我not如他们

special_situations.event: 尝试约会但not顺利（如网络约会受挫）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one date fails, the reason must be my disability; one failure means every future one will fail too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 短暂尝试后迅速Withdrawal，减少继续尝试约会的频率
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 果然have not人会愿意和像我这样的人在一起

special_situations.event: 想到自己的not yet来与亲密关系
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我现在找not到伴侣，将来也not会找到；Loneliness会一直持续
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing investment and self-care to avoid being disappointed again

special_situations.event: 回想三年前那次分手经历
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果关系破裂，说明我本质上not值得被爱，且残疾是关键原因
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids intimacy and emotional investment to avoid being rejected and hurt again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那次分手证明了我no hope

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and loved, to build a stable intimate partner relationship
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因残疾Being rejected、被贬低并持续Loneliness
defense_goal: 通过Avoids socializing与亲密来降低Being rejected的风险
以悲观Anticipation和自我贬低来降低失望感、获得伪控制感

object_relations.self_representation: 有缺陷、not值得被爱的个体
object_relations.object_representation: Others/potential partners who may judge or reject oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes reality testing and invites me to look at evidence contrary to the belief
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为咨询师可能在negate自己的现实感受，并坚信“证据都支持我的看法”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Insists 'that is the fact' in the tone of objective evidence; polite but guarded in tone, weakening acceptance of new viewpoints.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor takes friends' support and personal strengths as positive evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为友谊中的支持与恋爱without关，从而与情感保持距离
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use概念区分（如“友情≠恋爱”），语气平静，拉开情感距离以避免被触动。

manifestations: 分手后长期感到Loneliness与悲伤
认为残疾导致without法建立亲密关系
因身体残疾without法行走，主观体验到“被限制、被阻碍”
Understands disability as the core obstacle affecting romantic choices and opportunities
outcomes: 回避外出与社交，感到Restricted choices
对not yet来形成悲观、宿命式Anticipation

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: When talking about dating setbacks, presumes potential partners will reject them because of their disability (lacking direct evidence)
看到情侣时自动判断自己not会被接纳，将他人的假想评价内化为事实

exception_events.target_problem: 在与他人建立亲密关系的情境下，周伟通常会因“not人会要我”的想法而Reduced socializing并Withdrawal，进一步加剧Loneliness。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在与一位长期支持他的朋友的关系中（如那次朋友买车赠与），他体验到被重视与被接纳，关系稳固且积极，呈现出与主导故事not同的连结经验。
exception_events.reason: not同支持：朋友提供持续的情感与实际支持；not同理解：朋友欣赏他“善于Listening、Humor”；关系not同：非浪漫关系降低评价Anxiety，使其更能接收正向反馈。

positive_force: Has a supportive network of friends（朋友给予重大实际支持，如赠车）
具备被他人认可的优点（善于Listening、有Humor感）
Willing to seek help and try new methods (seeking counseling, reading therapy books)
能在咨询中进行Reflection并愿意逐步尝试现实检验
negative_force: 根深蒂固的负性核心信念（“我有缺陷/我注定找not到伴侣”）
Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and mind reading maintaining the problem
Social avoidance与自我照顾下降，减少正向经验的获得
Unemployment与Living alone状态减少日常社交接触与外界反馈

antecedent: 想到关于not yet来的负面Anticipation
target_behavior.core_reason: Believes 'disability will hinder me from finding a partner', avoids to escape rejection and shame
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的结果（Being rejected、被比较）与情绪痛苦
target_behavior.consequence: 减少结识新人的机会，Loneliness维持或加重

target_behavior.behavior: 自我照顾与Reduced engagement in daily activities
antecedent: 在社交与约会受挫后的without望感
target_behavior.core_reason: 认为努力也without用的without望体验，导致Decreased drive
target_behavior.function: In the short term, reduces the pain of facing failure and disappointment
target_behavior.consequence: Daily functioning impaired; low mood maintained or worsening

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly engages in negative self-talk (catastrophizing, mind reading, overgeneralization)
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative core beliefs activated, automatic thoughts dominating information processing
target_behavior.function: 通过悲观Anticipation获得伪控制感，避免再次抱有希望后失望
target_behavior.consequence: without望与自卑感Reinforcement，进一步削弱社交尝试与自我照顾
